findings.title: Security Incident Updates
findings.summary_md: College Board's November 27 security update says unauthorized activity reached systems used to create student and professional accounts and submit CSS Profile applications. It says actors accessed basic account information for a subset of users and initiated password resets in some cases, while new account creation and CSS Profile were temporarily unavailable and existing accounts had reduced functionality. The page is stamped Updated 11.27.2026 8:30 PM EST and reports no evidence of improper access to the test-score and exam-content repository.
